## TRA Timeline

#### X-energy business combination announcement

- 2022-12-05: 8-K announces Business Combination Agreement with X-energy Reactor Company, LLC; Up-C structure with 85% TRA contemplated at closing
- 2023-01-25: S-4 first attaches the form-of TRA as Annex I
- 2023-10-13: Definitive 424B3 joint proxy/prospectus filed; Annex I form-of TRA included

#### Termination

- 2023-10-31: AAC and X-energy mutually terminate the BCA; TRA never executed
- 2023-11-20: AAC files Form 15-12G deregistering

## Explanation

In December 2022, Ares Acquisition Corp signed a Business Combination Agreement with X-energy Reactor Company, LLC that would have created an Up-C public company entering an 85% Tax Receivable Agreement with X-energy members covering basis step-ups from future Common Unit exchanges. The form-of TRA appeared as Annex I to the joint proxy/prospectus across several S-4 iterations and the definitive 424B3, but the preamble date was blank and the contemplated obligor was the post-closing X-energy, Inc., not AAC itself. On October 31, 2023, the parties mutually terminated the BCA before the AAC shareholder vote, and AAC deregistered roughly three weeks later. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
